k-nearest neighbours classifier.

Classifies each row by the votes of its nearest training rows, computed on the selected device (scikit-learn's KNeighborsClassifier), and appends a prediction column.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Analytics](../categories/analytics.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Also read from graphs as | `KNNClassifier` |
| Search words | knn, nearest, neighbor, neighbour, classifier, classic ml |

| **Data** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | Input table with features and target column |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Predictions** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | Input table plus prediction column |
| **Model** | Parameters | No | 1 | Fitted KNN model (its training rows and settings) |

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Columns | Target column | `target_col` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Target label column in the input table. Required. |
| Columns | Feature columns | `feature_cols` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Comma-separated numeric features; empty auto-detects numeric columns except the target. |
| Output | Prediction column | `prediction_col` | Text | `prediction` |   | The run | Name of the appended prediction column. |
| Output | Probability columns | `probability_columns` | On / off | `false` |   | The run | Also append one probability column per class, named &lt;prediction column>_p_&lt;class> (for ROC and precision-recall) |
| Artifact | Save model path | `model_path` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | JSON path to save the fitted model; empty saves it in the project's artifacts. |
| Model | Neighbours | `n_neighbors` | Integer | `5` |   | The run | Training rows that vote for each prediction. |
| Model | Weights | `weights` | Choice | `uniform` | `uniform`, `distance` | The run | Every neighbour votes equally, or closer neighbours count more (1/distance) |
| Model | Distance metric | `metric` | Choice | `euclidean` | `euclidean`, `manhattan`, `cosine` | The run | Distance between rows. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | Yes; the result can be saved as a table |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.
